product_name: energy vial supplement (synthetic example, based on a real ad's unboxing-and-drink demo, not a real product)
source_material_note: Derived from the narrative SHAPE (a single continuous unboxing-then-drink demo with a same-day energy callback, not the literal wording) of a real English-language hat-graded TikTok ad transcript reviewed during this skill's build (see sources.md for the line reference; no transcript text is reproduced here). Text-only degraded Class A path (workflow.md Phase 1 step 5) -- identity anchors below are synthetic archetypes, not vision-reversed from any real photo. The source ad's unvisualizable internal-health/anti-aging mechanism claims are intentionally NOT carried into the frames below -- only the physically demonstrable unboxing/drinking action and a plausible energy-level expression change are kept.
